verdict.rationale: Polar documents self-serve card acceptance: no-code Checkout Links you configure once and share anywhere, plus embedded and API checkouts. A free Starter plan and the Merchant of Record model mean Polar charges customers even where Stripe isn't available. Speed claims ("set up in minutes from an existing store", "6 lines of code") suggest a fast path, but nothing documents how long a new account takes to go live for real payments. missing for 10: evidence of account verification/onboarding review time before live payments, a documented time-to-first-live-payment for brand-new sign-ups, independent or hands-on corroboration.
